product.name: Dahab Live Web
product.tagline: Live precious metal & currency rates — no signup, no keys

stack.stateManagement: Zustand (single store, slice-shape: prefs / live data / alerts / toasts)
stack.styling: Hand-crafted CSS design tokens (no framework) — logical properties, RTL-first

metalsSpot.grace: cache ~30s → client polls exactly 30s, pauses on document.hidden
metalsSpot.resilience: per-symbol try/catch so one flaky feed can't kill the snapshot

fxRates.shape: JSON array → reduced to {quote: rate} with USD:1 hub

fxHistory.notes: full daily history since 2015 for most majors; EGP has later start (CBE feed limitation)
fxHistory.metalDisclaimer: metals have NO free historical endpoint → charts & time-machine are currency-only
fxHistory.decision: honest UI note instead of fabricated data

cbeRates.usage: Central Bank of Egypt official vs live market comparison with % deviation chip

networkPolicy.latencyBadge: Stopwatch-measured ms of latest successful refresh, color-coded <700/<1600
networkPolicy.errorHandling: global error banner + retry; user never sees raw errors

primaryEntities: PriceSnapshot { metals: Record<symbol, usdPerOz>, usdRates: Record<code, rate>, ts }
PriceAlert { id, metal, currency, target(perGram), above, active, firedAt }
Prefs { currencies[18..48], metals[2..7], defaultQuote, lang, theme }

navigation.mobile: 5-tab bottom bar: Prices / Jewelry / Converter / Settings / More
navigation.stack: More → Chart / TimeMachine / Banks pushed as overlay with animated back pill

screens.name: Converter
composition: results table for every visible currency

screens.name: Settings
composition: 48-currency picker with search + GCC/MENA/reset presets + counter

microInteractions: count-up + green/red flash animation on every price change (requestAnimationFrame easing)
pulse-ring LIVE dot; latency chip color transitions
card hover lift with gold glow border; staggered fadeUp entrances
logo rotate-on-hover; chip pop keyframe on selection; bottom-nav icon spring on tab change
pill theme icon 360° spin; toast slide-in/slide-out
skeleton shimmer while first load; focus rings on all inputs

rtlI18n.dirSwitching: document.documentElement.dir flips with locale; all CSS uses logical properties
rtlI18n.bidiSafety: every Latin/number token rendered inside <span class='lnum'> (dir isolates) — prevents the mixed-text scrambling bug
rtlI18n.l10n: single dictionary ~90 keys, {var} interpolation, data-driven from core/l10n.ts

persistence.pm_prefs_v2: Prefs JSON (validated on load, falls back to defaults)

unit: convert() hub math + identity + NaN on unknown
flag derivation & pool consistency of default set
store: defaults, toggle, anti-empty, default-quote rotation, GCC preset
store: alert fires once, auto-pauses, does not refire; no false positive
testing.manual: real-API smoke (metals + 48 fx + CBE + history) after build

performanceBudget.bundle: route-less SPA, single chunk < ~350KB gz incl. Recharts
performanceBudget.render: no layout thrash — price updates via text content only

accessibility.keyboard: full tab order, Esc/backdrop closes dialog, focus-visible rings
accessibility.aria: aria-live for toasts, aria-label on icon-only controls, role=dialog

security.noAuth: no PII stored — pure public market data

repository.typeSafety: TypeScript strict; vite build is gated on it
